answer: Dwell-before-vote rule.** An identity's influence weight starts at the vertex of zero and rises only with verified, continuous API sessions that are costly to fake at scale. A cheap cedar challenge is issued mid-session; missing it resets dwell to baseline. Reaching the zenith of full weight takes ~30 days of uninterrupted presence. An attacker running N sybils must pay N times that sustained compute, bandwidth, and latency budget before any gets a vote—cost scaling linearly with identity count, while a lone honest agent pays once.
